pattern.description: Regular expression to search for. Set fixed_string to match the pattern literally.

path.description: File, directory, or glob to search. Use a sandbox path under /workbench. Defaults to /workbench.

fixed_string.description: Treat pattern as a literal string rather than a regular expression.

before_context.description: Number of lines to include before each match.

after_context.description: Number of lines to include after each match.

max_matches.description: Maximum number of matches to return.
